test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Dilip is immediate neighbour of both Priya and Payal. Priti is immediate neighbour of both Mukesh and Leela. Payal is sitting to the immediate right of Mukesh. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Priya?
solution:
Given: Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) Payal is sitting to the immediate right of Mukesh.

2) Priti is the immediate neighbor of both Mukesh and Leela.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6da6bb06aab781d0e11b6a1137ebacc911ecfaf8bdf1097aabf79b3aa5c2cfff.png] 

3) Dilip is the immediate neighbor of both Priya and Payal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c50dc37267652bc57f319d214c71293dd882fcd08549a2d3d37a8b364c34343b.png] 

'Leela' is sitting to the immediate right of Priya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Leela"**.
